O.outcome_detail: research skills in undergraduate nutrition students

O.outcome_detail: availability and quality of assessment tools for evaluating EBM TTT courses

cells.quote: There were no specific assessment tools for evaluating effectiveness of EBM TTT courses. Some of the material available might be useful in initiating the development of such an assessment tool.
cells.note: Systematic review of five papers; the study reports a gap in assessment tools rather than a quantitative treatment-comparison effect. Included courses varied from 1 day to 24 months and used diverse assessment methods.

O.outcome_detail: EBP knowledge, skills, attitudes and overall competence

cells.quote: Existing evidence supports, however, the idea that MI have been demonstrated more likely to improve knowledge, skills, and attitudes compared to SI offered over a short duration or to no interventions [4,27]. MI, with combinations of methods including lectures, computer sessions, small group discussions, journal clubs, and assignments were more likely to improve knowledge, skills, and attitude compared to SI or no interventions.
cells.note: The review did not report a pooled effect size; the entry's quoted descriptive statement about EBP domains does not itself specify a treatment-comparison outcome contrast.
